scenarios.label: Pharma Supply Chain
scenarios.description: Pharmaceutical delivery planning — catchment analysis, drug demand, route optimisation

prompts.label: 1. Catchment analysis
prompts.prompt: Show me the population health profile within a 10 minute drive of Walgreens at 498 Castro Street, San Francisco

prompts.label: 2. Drug demand
prompts.prompt: Based on that catchment population, what drugs would this pharmacy need most? Consider the diabetes, hypertension, cardiovascular and respiratory rates.

prompts.label: 3. Patient directions
prompts.prompt: Give me driving directions from 742 Valencia Street, San Francisco to Walgreens at 498 Castro Street

prompts.label: 4. Cycling access
prompts.prompt: Show me a 5 minute cycling isochrone from 498 Castro Street, San Francisco for patients without cars

prompts.label: 5. Supply chain plan
prompts.prompt: Plan the full pharmaceutical supply chain delivery from the depot to all SF pharmacies using 3 specialist vehicles

scenarios.label: Fleet Analytics
scenarios.description: Fleet performance analytics — trips, speed, compliance, dwell time, battery, vehicle comparison

prompts.label: 1. Fleet overview
prompts.prompt: Give me an overview of the fleet: total trips, average distance, average duration, and number of active vehicles

prompts.label: 2. Top performers
prompts.prompt: Which vehicles completed the most trips and what was their average distance and duration?

prompts.label: 3. Speed & compliance
prompts.prompt: What is the speeding rate by vehicle? Which couriers have the most speed violations?

prompts.label: 4. Dwell & idle time
prompts.prompt: What percentage of time do vehicles spend moving vs dwelling vs idle?

prompts.label: 5. Battery health
prompts.prompt: Which vehicles have the lowest battery levels? Show average and minimum battery by courier.

prompts.label: 6. Busiest locations
prompts.prompt: Which pickup locations have the most orders? What are the top 10 busiest restaurants?

prompts.label: 7. Hourly patterns
prompts.prompt: What is the trip distribution by hour of day? When is peak demand?

scenarios.label: Retail & Catchment
scenarios.description: Retail site analysis — competitor proximity, drive-time catchments, POI discovery

prompts.label: 1. Store catchment
prompts.prompt: Show me the area reachable within a 10 minute drive from Union Square, San Francisco

prompts.label: 2. Nearby competitors
prompts.prompt: Show me all shops and shopping malls within a 10 minute drive from Union Square, San Francisco

prompts.label: 3. Restaurants
prompts.prompt: Show me restaurants within a 15 minute drive from the Ferry Building, San Francisco

prompts.label: 4. Drive to store
prompts.prompt: Get driving directions from 3100 Scott Street, San Francisco to Union Square

prompts.label: 5. Multi-store route
prompts.prompt: Get driving directions from a warehouse at 1 Market Street to Pier 39, then to Fisherman's Wharf, then to Ghirardelli Square, San Francisco

scenarios.label: Pharma Manufacturing
scenarios.description: Upstream supply chain intelligence — API suppliers, manufacturing plants, batch production, shipment delays, cold chain risk

prompts.label: 1. Supply chain status
prompts.prompt: Give me an overview of our manufacturing supply chain status. Which products are critically low on raw materials and which batches are currently on hold or have quality failures?

prompts.label: 2. Supplier risk
prompts.prompt: Which suppliers have a reliability score below 80% or are on GMP probation? What products do they supply and what is the single-source risk?

prompts.label: 3. Batch quality
prompts.prompt: Show me all production batches with critical or major deviations, quality failures, or that are currently on hold. What is the total batch cost at risk?

prompts.label: 4. Shipment delays
prompts.prompt: Which inbound API shipments are currently delayed or held in customs? Are any cold chain shipments at risk of temperature excursion? What is the total value at risk?

prompts.label: 5. End-to-end risk
prompts.prompt: Identify the highest-risk product in our portfolio — low stock at both manufacturing and pharmacy level, with supplier reliability concerns. Which patients could be affected and what should we do?

scenarios.label: Pharma Supply Intelligence
scenarios.description: Manufacturing & supply analytics — wastage, demand forecasting from demographics, replenishment planning, stock redistribution

prompts.label: 1. Wastage alert
prompts.prompt: Show me the current inventory status across all pharmacies. Which drugs are critically low or near expiry, and what is the total wastage cost this month?

prompts.label: 2. Cold chain wastage
prompts.prompt: Which cold chain products have the highest wastage? Show me the drugs with less than 30 days until expiry and the cost of stock we are likely to waste.

prompts.label: 3. Demand forecast
prompts.prompt: Based on the demographics around Walgreens Mission District, what are the top drugs needed and how does the current stock compare to forecast demand?

prompts.label: 4. Replenishment plan
prompts.prompt: Generate an urgent replenishment plan. Which pharmacies need immediate restocking, starting with cold chain products first? Show units required and total order value.

prompts.label: 5. Redistribute stock
prompts.prompt: Identify which pharmacies are overstocked on insulin and cold chain products with less than 30 days expiry. Then optimise a redistribution route from the overstocked pharmacies to the ones that are critically low.

scenarios.label: Weather-Aware Routing
scenarios.description: Real-time Met Office weather — check conditions before deploying cyclists, adjust routes for fog, wind and rain

prompts.label: 1. Current conditions
prompts.prompt: What are the current weather conditions in San Francisco? Is it safe to send out e-bike couriers?

prompts.label: 2. Visibility check
prompts.prompt: Check the visibility in San Francisco. Should we avoid cycling routes today?

prompts.label: 3. Wind impact
prompts.prompt: What is the wind speed in San Francisco right now? Which vehicle profiles are safe to use?

prompts.label: 4. Weather + routing
prompts.prompt: Check the weather first, then plan the best route from 1 Market Street to 498 Castro Street using the safest vehicle profile for today's conditions

prompts.label: 5. Delivery planning
prompts.prompt: Given today's weather in San Francisco, optimise a delivery route from the depot at 1 Market Street to Walgreens 498 Castro St, CVS 2676 Geary Blvd, and Rite Aid 801 Clement St. Recommend the safest vehicle type.

scenarios.label: Plant Intelligence
scenarios.description: Manufacturing plant operations — batch hold alerts, temperature excursions, critical stock, shipment delays. Open Plant Intelligence map alongside to see buildings light up by severity.

prompts.label: 1. Plant alert status
prompts.prompt: Which of our manufacturing plants are in a critical state right now? Show me the alert severity for each plant, including batch holds, temperature excursions, and delayed shipments.

prompts.label: 2. Batch holds at risk
prompts.prompt: Show me all production batches currently on hold or rejected across our plants. Which plant has the most value at risk and what are the root causes?

prompts.label: 3. Cold chain excursions
prompts.prompt: Are there any active temperature excursions across our manufacturing plants? Which products are affected and what is the risk to batch integrity?

prompts.label: 4. Material shortages
prompts.prompt: Which plants have critical raw material shortages that could halt production? Show me the days of coverage remaining for each critical material.

prompts.label: 5. Mount Vernon deep-dive
prompts.prompt: Give me a full operational status report for the Mount Vernon plant — active batches, quality deviations, material stock levels, and any inbound shipment delays.

scenarios.label: Fleet Logistics
scenarios.description: Fleet delivery optimisation — multi-vehicle routing with capacity and skills

prompts.label: 1. Pharma fleet demo
prompts.prompt: Run the SF pharmaceutical fleet delivery demo

prompts.label: 2. HGV directions
prompts.prompt: Get driving directions for a heavy goods vehicle from the Port of San Francisco to 4150 Clement Street

prompts.label: 3. Bike courier
prompts.prompt: Get cycling directions from 1 Market Street to 498 Castro Street, San Francisco

prompts.label: 4. Reachability
prompts.prompt: Show me the area reachable within 20 minutes by HGV from the Port of San Francisco

prompts.label: 5. Custom route
prompts.prompt: I have 2 vehicles starting from 1 Market Street, San Francisco. Optimise routes to deliver to: Walgreens 498 Castro St, CVS 2676 Geary Blvd, Rite Aid 801 Clement St, and Walgreens 2690 Mission St
